sailing-the-seas-of-cheese.pork-soda: Same cartoon, thicker mud. The riffs get uglier and the jokes stop winking.
sailing-the-seas-of-cheese.frizzle-fry: Back one door. Dirtier guitar, smaller budget, already fully formed.
sailing-the-seas-of-cheese.tales-from-the-punchbowl: Keep the bass-as-narrator trick, add the story-song peak.
sailing-the-seas-of-cheese.riddles-are-abound-tonight: Hear the 1988 lineup before LaLonde and Herb became the brand.
sailing-the-seas-of-cheese.purple-onion: Skip the metal. Keep the swamp and the Whamola.

frizzle-fry.sailing-the-seas-of-cheese: The usual door is still waiting. Hits, still weird.
frizzle-fry.pork-soda: Darker and thicker. Platinum Primus with more mud on the boots.
frizzle-fry.suck-on-this: Even rawer, and live. Year-zero club tape.
frizzle-fry.riddles-are-abound-tonight: Todd Huth's guitar language, billed later as Sausage.

pork-soda.tales-from-the-punchbowl: Keep the stories, add more color. Wynona, pachyderms, Nutbutter.
pork-soda.brown-album: Brain replaces Herb. Chunkier drums, drier mud.
pork-soda.highball-with-the-devil: The narrator clocks out of Primus. Holy Mackerel, mostly Les.
pork-soda.antipop: If you want it angrier. Guests, producers, pre-hiatus restlessness.

suck-on-this.frizzle-fry: Same animal, studio lights. The debut proper, still raw.
suck-on-this.sailing-the-seas-of-cheese: Jump to the breakthrough if you already know you can hang.
suck-on-this.riddles-are-abound-tonight: The lineup before this lineup. Huth and Lane, billed as Sausage.

tales-from-the-punchbowl.sailing-the-seas-of-cheese: If you want the singles back. Jerry and Tommy still live here.
tales-from-the-punchbowl.brown-album: The drummer changes. The mud stays.
tales-from-the-punchbowl.highball-with-the-devil: The storyteller without the band. Rancho Relaxo, 1996.

brown-album.antipop: Guests and grit. Last pre-hiatus Primus record.
brown-album.rhinoplasty: Covers and leftovers from the same Brain-era desk.
brown-album.the-big-eyeball-in-the-sky: Brain plus Buckethead plus Worrell. The rhythm section leaves the name behind.
brown-album.tales-from-the-punchbowl: Miss Herb? Go back one record.

antipop.the-big-eyeball-in-the-sky: Same restless mood, no Primus name. C2B3 takes the kit elsewhere.
antipop.animals-should-not-try-to-act-like-peopl: Herb walks back in. Hiatus over, EP-length.
antipop.of-whales-and-woe: Leave the band name entirely. Fancy Band Claypool.
antipop.green-naugahyde: The later reboot. Lane on drums, bounce restored.

animals-should-not-try-to-act-like-peopl.green-naugahyde: A full later album. Lane-era Primus, 2011.
animals-should-not-try-to-act-like-peopl.sailing-the-seas-of-cheese: The record they toured in full as a second-set trick.
animals-should-not-try-to-act-like-peopl.antipop: What they walked away from. 1999 restlessness.
animals-should-not-try-to-act-like-peopl.the-desaturating-seven: Later concept Primus with Herb back in the chair.

green-naugahyde.riddles-are-abound-tonight: Lane's first Claypool record, decades earlier. Sausage, 1994.
green-naugahyde.primus-and-the-chocolate-factory: The next Primus left turn. Wonka, mutated.
green-naugahyde.the-desaturating-seven: Herb-era concept, later. Goblins instead of bounce.
green-naugahyde.of-whales-and-woe: The solo years that preceded the reboot.

rhinoplasty.miscellaneous-debris: The earlier covers EP. XTC and The Residents.
rhinoplasty.antipop: New originals, restless ones. Last 90s album.
rhinoplasty.lime-and-limpid-green: Covers, Delirium edition. A later sacred-cow set.
rhinoplasty.brown-album: The parent album era. Brain-era studio Primus.

miscellaneous-debris.sailing-the-seas-of-cheese: Back to the parent album this EP sat beside.
miscellaneous-debris.rhinoplasty: Another covers EP, later. Peter Gabriel, X, Stanley Clarke.
miscellaneous-debris.lime-and-limpid-green: Sacred-cow covers, Delirium edition. Floyd, Crimson, the Who.

highball-with-the-devil.of-whales-and-woe: The proper solo sequel. Fancy Band DNA, 2006.
highball-with-the-devil.purple-onion: Swamp-psych with a full brigade. Frogs, Whamola, studio.
highball-with-the-devil.four-foot-shack: Peel the distortion off. Overalls and covers.
highball-with-the-devil.brown-album: Back to the day job. Brain-era Primus continues.

of-whales-and-woe.of-fungi-and-foe: The companion solo. Soundtrack leftovers, still him.
of-whales-and-woe.purple-onion: The band that led here. Frog Brigade studio.
of-whales-and-woe.four-foot-shack: Twang detour. Acoustic, overalls, same songs.

of-fungi-and-foe.of-whales-and-woe: The stronger solo statement. Start here if you landed on the sequel first.
of-fungi-and-foe.four-foot-shack: Acoustic. Duo de Twang peels it back.
of-fungi-and-foe.green-naugahyde: Primus returns. 2011 bounce after the solo years.

purple-onion.of-whales-and-woe: Fancy Band solo. The next studio voice for this band-shape.
purple-onion.live-frogs-set-1: Hear the Brigade live. Set 1 is the jam document.
purple-onion.the-big-eyeball-in-the-sky: Experimental freakouts. C2B3, no frogs required.
purple-onion.monolith-of-phobos: Psych without the frogs. The Lennon duo.

live-frogs-set-1.live-frogs-set-2: The Animals cover set. Pink Floyd, start to finish.
live-frogs-set-1.purple-onion: Studio frogs. Whamola and David Makalaster.

live-frogs-set-2.purple-onion: Original frogs. The studio Brigade record.
live-frogs-set-2.lime-and-limpid-green: More sacred-cow covers. Delirium does Floyd and Crimson.

four-foot-shack.of-whales-and-woe: Electric solo. Fancy Band Claypool with the distortion back on.
four-foot-shack.sailing-the-seas-of-cheese: Hear Jerry in its original boots. These songs like to get twanged.
four-foot-shack.purple-onion: Swamp without the country. Frog Brigade studio.

riddles-are-abound-tonight.frizzle-fry: What that lineup became. Primus after Huth left.
riddles-are-abound-tonight.purple-onion: Huth and Lane return as frogs. The Brigade is the spiritual sequel.
riddles-are-abound-tonight.green-naugahyde: Lane back in Primus, decades later. Bouncier 2010s Primus.
riddles-are-abound-tonight.highball-with-the-devil: Claypool without LaLonde. Another non-Primus studio.

the-grand-pecking-order.monolith-of-phobos: The later psych-prog duo. Claypool Lennon Delirium.
the-grand-pecking-order.tales-from-the-punchbowl: If you missed Primus tightness. Back to story-song Primus.
the-grand-pecking-order.south-of-reality: Delirium's second flight. Often cited as their best.

monolith-of-phobos.south-of-reality: The stronger second record. 2019, tighter and stranger.
monolith-of-phobos.lime-and-limpid-green: The covers EP. Floyd, Crimson, the Who, the Beatles.
monolith-of-phobos.the-great-parrot-ox: The 2026 concept. AI morality and a comic book.
monolith-of-phobos.purple-onion: Swamp-psych cousin. Frogs instead of space stations.

south-of-reality.monolith-of-phobos: The first Delirium. How the duo started.
south-of-reality.the-great-parrot-ox: The later concept. 2026, still the same two weirdos.
south-of-reality.the-desaturating-seven: Primus concept. Goblins instead of planets.
south-of-reality.the-grand-pecking-order: Supergroup prog. Oysterhead, one record, done.

lime-and-limpid-green.monolith-of-phobos: Delirium originals, first album. Start of the duo.
lime-and-limpid-green.live-frogs-set-2: Another sacred-cow cover set. Animals, live.

the-great-parrot-ox.south-of-reality: Previous Delirium peak. 2019, before the parable.
the-great-parrot-ox.monolith-of-phobos: Start of the duo. 2016, still finding the orbit.
the-great-parrot-ox.conspiranoid: Primus on the present tense. 2022 EP, talkier.

the-desaturating-seven.south-of-reality: Prog-psych storytelling without the Primus name.
the-desaturating-seven.primus-and-the-chocolate-factory: Previous story record. Wonka, already mutated.
the-desaturating-seven.conspiranoid: Recent Primus. The 2022 EP, shorter and newsier.

primus-and-the-chocolate-factory.tales-from-the-punchbowl: Classic narrative Primus if you missed the 90s stories.
primus-and-the-chocolate-factory.monolith-of-phobos: Studio psych color. Delirium, not Wonka.

conspiranoid.the-desaturating-seven: Recent full Primus. The last studio album before the EP.
conspiranoid.antipop: Restless Primus. 1999 energy, different news cycle.
conspiranoid.the-great-parrot-ox: Current-events psych from Delirium. AI morality opera.
conspiranoid.green-naugahyde: 2010s Primus. The reboot, before the concepts.

the-big-eyeball-in-the-sky.of-whales-and-woe: Solo after the supergroup. Fewer guests, more Claypool.
the-big-eyeball-in-the-sky.antipop: Primus at its most restless. The 90s cousin of this mood.
the-big-eyeball-in-the-sky.monolith-of-phobos: Another mutant duo. Delirium instead of C2B3.
the-big-eyeball-in-the-sky.highball-with-the-devil: DIY Claypool. Holy Mackerel, no Buckethead required.
